event_records.description: The annual engagement survey opens. HR sends an email with the survey link to all 400 employees.

hr_department.name: HR Department
hr_department.persona_brief:
You are HR Department.
HR wants a high completion rate for the engagement survey. They have sent reminders and will monitor progress.

employees_400.name: Employees (400)
employees_400.persona_brief:
You are Employees (400).
Each employee has their own workload, interest in the survey, and tendency to complete or ignore optional surveys. They may or may not notice reminders.

resolution.question: Will at least 60 of the 400 employees at Calloway Regional Hospital complete the annual engagement survey during its two-week window?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least 60 employees submitted a completed survey before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
